$schema_note: MDO3 brand tokens v1 (2026-10-16). Builds on the MDO design system v0 in staged/proposal_2026-10-16/mockups/mdo-system.css. Source of truth for every MDO family and for BlacklabB. CSS mirrors: mdo-brand.css (MDO families), blacklabb.css (BlacklabB). v1.1 (Principal review 10-16): mdo3 family = the original mdo3d.com language (mdo3d.com, names, leads); rigor takes the yellow-and-black look; Ronna is its own identity outside the MDO families; index family kept as variant 2 for comparison.

rules.gradients: none on surfaces or text; a chart fill may use one flat accent at low opacity
rules.claims: show, don't say; honest numbers only; never the word free; no .99 prices
rules.offer: one offer and one next step per screen
rules.imagery: real artefacts (cards, data, rows, filings) framed in a 1px hairline box with a caption; no stock illustration
rules.italic_note: Principal 10-16: "stop using italics" for MDO and Rigor. No italic font-style, no italic font files or ital axes in font links; em/i/cite/q/blockquote render upright; emphasis by colour or weight.

throughline.description: Shared by every MDO family. Same grid, header, footer, label style, corners and hairlines; each family swaps face and accent.

components.header: full-width, 1px rule below; mark + wordmark left; uppercase ui nav 13px/600/0.08em right; one primary button max
components.footer: 1px rule above; legal entity name, privacy, terms, contact; mute 13px
components.label: ui 12px/600, uppercase, 0.14em, mute
components.button.primary: accent fill, bg-colored text, ui 15px/600, 14px 22px, radius md
components.button.ghost: transparent, fg text, 1px rule border, radius md
components.box: 1px rule border on all sides, radius md, no shadow
components.tag: ui 11px/600 uppercase 0.1em, 1px rule border, radius sm, mute text (never a pill)
components.table: head: label style over a 1px fg rule; rows: 1px rule; numbers in mono, right aligned
components.figure: 1px rule frame, radius md, caption below in mute 13px with source + date
components.states: empty (what it is + one action), loading (static skeleton rows, no spinners over 1s), error (plain sentence + retry), success (inline confirmation, no modal)

index.voice: plain index of what MDO3D makes; numbers that are true today
index.status: variant 2 of 3 (yellow and black); its look now proposed for Rigor; mdo3d.com stays on mdo3

guidance.voice: ceremonial, measured; the draw first, the price next to it
guidance.imagery: real card art (Rider-Waite-Smith 1909, public domain) or in-house line art for runes, hexagrams, glyphs

data.voice: show the data itself, then one offer; editorial headline over real rows
data.imagery: a real chart (weekly volume line) and real sample rows in a framed table

tools.voice: quiet utility; the tool is the hero
tools.mark: m3 in mono, 3 in accent; wordmark always mono (one face across hub and tools)

rigor.voice: plain and exact about what each tool returns; example output labelled illustrative
rigor.mark: 'R' in a 1.5px yellow square outline beside 'Rigor' in Inter Tight 700
rigor.note: the yellow-and-black MDO variant (Principal 10-16). Alternates A (Paper & Ink) and B (Path) on design/rigor-a|b-2026-10-16.

mdo3.voice: the original mdo3d.com: editorial serif headlines with an italic accent phrase, quiet sans text, mono labels
mdo3.mark: 28px filled accent square, 'M3' in JetBrains Mono, white

blacklabb.description: Blacklab B: its own identity, deliberately distinct from every MDO family (cold graphite instrument panel, grotesk + mono, crosshair mark, per-tracker signal colour). Never shares MDO's warm paper, serif faces or gold. Never depends on blacklabb.com: hosts come from one config (js/sites.js).
blacklabb.voice: a precise personal log for following a frontier field; instrument-like, dated, sourced
blacklabb.mark: a crosshair (circle + 4 ticks) beside BLACKLAB in mono caps, the B in a solid square
motifs: 8px dot grid at 4% opacity on page background

components.filter: segmented control: joined 1px-bordered cells, active cell filled with fg (no pills)
components.entry: row on a 1px rule: mono index + date column, title + source, category tag in signal colour outline
components.modal: sheet with a 1px frame and corner ticks; full-height on mobile

ronna.description: Ronna keeps its own identity, separate from the MDO families (Principal 10-16: 'i dont think it needs to be continuous with ronna scanner'). CSS: css/ronna-brand.css in each Ronna repo, body class 'rs ronna'.
ronna.mark: RS monogram in a 1px square, Plex Sans 700
